Fixed in PR #88 (superseded PR #86). Root cause: requestAuthorization fired correctly, but for an LSUIElement app macOS presents the prompt as an ordinary corner banner with Allow revealed only on hover - no modal, no dock bounce. Left unanswered and then quit, macOS records the answer as PERMANENTLY denied, after which requestAuthorization returns UNErrorDomain code 1 immediately and add() silently no-ops. The old { _, _ in } callback discarded both the grant and the error, so the dead end left no trace. Ruled out empirically with throwaway bundle ids: the App.init() call site, LSUIElement blocking presentation, needing to be frontmost, and the app being quit before the callback completed. Fix: ReminderAuthorization value type + NotificationAuthorizer protocol mirroring LoginItemSetting/LoginItemRegistrar; the popover renders the problem with an Open Notification Settings button and refreshes on .task so granting clears it without a relaunch. Verified on a fresh bundle id: prompt presented AND app listed in System Settings.

Implemented across PR #87 (demolition) and PR #88 (construction). ThrowntomAlert target, the Go alert plumbing, findAlertHelper and the darwinNotifier alert methods are gone; the Notifier interface is back to PlaySound only. The macOS app now posts the reminder itself on awaiting_confirm via a pure ReminderBanner.decide(from:to:authorization:) over two daemon states, with a thin ReminderPresenter adapter, and answers Snooze/Confirm in-process through the same DaemonClient path as every other button. Verified on-device: one banner across 32s of continuous awaiting_confirm frames, Snooze produced a snoozed event in the daemon log, Confirm advanced awaiting_confirm to short_break, and both leaving the phase and quitting the app withdrew the banner. KNOWN GAP: throwntom-ux2 - the cycle snooze publishes no state change, so a snooze that expires resumes the sound with no banner. Cause is upstream in handleSnooze/App.Snooze; decide() already handles a non-nil snooze_until correctly.

Resolved by throwntom-0ej (PRs #87, #88) per ADR-003. The buttons now work: the macOS app posts the notification itself, so the process holding it is the one that stays alive and can answer. Verified on-device 2026-08-27 - clicking Snooze produced a snoozed event in the daemon log and clicking Confirm advanced awaiting_confirm to short_break, where before neither reached the daemon at all. Note for the record: this bead's original evidence criterion (snooze_until stayed null) was the wrong field - snooze_until is only ever set by the morning path, so it would have been null here even had the button worked. See throwntom-ux2, which tracks the separate remaining gap that a cycle snooze publishes no state change and so no banner returns when it expires.

Resolved by throwntom-5ak and throwntom-0ej (PRs #87, #88). The code this bead describes no longer exists: ShowReminder is gone from the Notifier interface and startReminderLocked no longer posts anything, so there is no discarded error there to log. The underlying concern - the actionable-notification feature failing with no trace - is now addressed at the layer that actually posts: ReminderResponder keeps what macOS answered instead of discarding it, a post macOS rejects becomes ReminderAuthorization.rejected, and the popover renders the problem with an Open Notification Settings button. That is the visible signal this bead asked for.
